query: SELECT b.id, b.name, b.city, b.country, b.region, b.hub, b.description, bt.name as businessType, sc.name as sportCategory FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN businessTypes bt ON b.businessTypeId = bt.id LEFT JOIN sportCategories sc ON b.sportCategoryId = sc.id ORDER BY b.id;
command: mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway04.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user 4Tj6vDDLS3zPqro.root --database msZys4esiwaxadBmUrrxVF --execute SELECT b.id, b.name, b.city, b.country, b.region, b.hub, b.description, bt.name as businessType, sc.name as sportCategory FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN businessTypes bt ON b.businessTypeId = bt.id LEFT JOIN sportCategories sc ON b.sportCategoryId = sc.id ORDER BY b.id;
